name: @oge-ui/react-scheduler
description: React scheduler / event calendar from the OGE UI suite: day, work-week, week, month, agenda, timeline and year views, all-day strip, pure-kernel overlap layout, drag & resize with Escape-cancel, drag-to-create, recurrence with occurrence-vs-series editing, resource grouping, reminders, an anchored appointment popup and a form editor — running the same framework-free scheduler engine and the same stylesheet as the Angular @oge-ui/scheduler. Source-available commercial license (free for evaluation and development).
author: kaya2m
